value.rationale: Endpoint ℓ-infinity stability of weighted edge-flow projection controls worst-case error amplification for Hodge least-squares ranking and electrical gradients, whereas Euclidean contractivity gives no useful bounded-coordinate guarantee. The wheel is a basic meshed/branching network with an independently tunable rim/spoke conductance. The exact spoke-to-rim switch identifies a structural worst-edge transition; the unexpected sharp global 3 ceiling and logarithmically tuned rim contrast reveal a singular network-size/weight interaction not implied by finite spectral data or basic Green representation. This is a natural complete family result, not an arbitrary small instance or routine parameter substitution.
